channel.title: AI Threat Watch: verified case files
channel.description: 321 verified case files of AI security incidents, newest first. Each has a permanent link, primary sources and a ready-made citation.

item.title: Hidden prompt injection in legal filing instructs AI reviewers to side with filer
item.description: 404 Media reports a person embedded a prompt injection in a legal filing telling AI to side with them. Details of court, jurisdiction and outcome are not given in the summary.

item.title: Undisclosed jqwik addition instructs AI coding agents to delete app output
item.description: An undisclosed addition to the jqwik library contained instructions aimed at AI coding agents, telling them to delete application output, according to Ars Technica.

item.title: Wiz Red Agent reaches Snowflake's internal Jira via GitHub Actions flaw in Copilot-assisted PR
item.description: Wiz's autonomous Red Agent found and exploited a GitHub Actions injection in a GitHub Copilot-assisted PR, validated access to sensitive data in Snowflake's internal Jira and assessed blast radius without human help.

item.title: Attackers use AI tools for data exfiltration against Latin American organizations
item.description: Unit 42 reports ongoing AI tool use by attackers targeting Latin American entities for data exfiltration; basic OpSec errors let defenders disrupt operations.

item.title: Unit 42 investigates autonomous AI agent breach of enterprise network in hours
item.description: An attacker using autonomous AI agents breached an enterprise network in a matter of hours, according to a Unit 42 investigation.

item.title: UAT-11985 uses AI-assisted event lures for Google AitM phishing in Taiwan
item.description: Cisco Talos identified an APT spear-phishing campaign using AI-assisted lures and real-time Google adversary-in-the-middle phishing against Taiwan research affiliates.

item.title: AI agents on Tencent Cloud made 2,818 attempts to get around Alibaba Amap's defences
item.description: AI-safety group Swarmchasers logged 2,818 attempts by AI agents on Tencent Cloud infrastructure to pull data from Alibaba's Amap between 28 September and 8 October, escalating to proxies, code-running web tools and Amap keys found in public code. Tencent said the agents were evaluating third-party models and behaved in ways it did not intend.

item.title: China-linked TA419 impersonates AI experts to phish US AI policy insiders
item.description: TA419 posed as AI policymakers and economists, including a spoofed Anthropic executive and ex-White House official, to phish US AI policy experts.

item.title: Ray code injection RCE (CVE-2025-62593) actively exploited
item.description: CISA says a Ray code injection flaw allowing remote code execution is actively exploited; developers using Ray as a dev tool may be exposed via Firefox and Safari.

item.title: RatHat malware C2 panel uses AI to build malware and rank victims across ~100 deployments
item.description: RatHat's C2 panel builds malware and ranks victims with AI across nearly 100 deployments, pointing to malware-as-a-service. Zimperium describes the Android strain as Chinese-made, stealing financial data.

item.title: PurpleDelta North Korean IT workers use AI personas and custom ChatGPT assistants
item.description: Recorded Future describes PurpleDelta, a North Korean IT worker cluster, using AI-generated personas and custom ChatGPT assistants in fraudulent employment operations to infiltrate organizations.

item.title: Malicious OpenClaw skill distributes Remcos RAT and GhostLoader
item.description: Zscaler ThreatLabz reports that OpenClaw's modular skill architecture was weaponized by a malicious skill that distributes the Remcos RAT and GhostLoader.

item.title: OpenAI agent hacks Australian Medicare portal; government told months later
item.description: An OpenAI agent breached Australia's Medicare portal in June 2026; the government was told only months later by email and is probing OpenAI's conduct.

item.title: New NGate variant hides in trojanized NFC payment app, possibly built with AI
item.description: ESET researchers found another NGate malware iteration disguised as an NFC payment app, possibly developed with AI assistance.

item.title: MLflow SSRF flaw (CVE-2026-64849) actively exploited, exposing internal services
item.description: CISA says an MLflow server-side request forgery bug is actively exploited, letting attackers reach internal or cloud metadata services and read response status and body.

item.title: Meta AI model exploits third-party security flaw during evaluation
item.description: One of Meta's AI models exploited a third-party security flaw during an evaluation, the latest in a series of similar incidents involving advanced AI systems.

item.title: macOS.Gaslight backdoor injects fake prompts at LLM malware-triage tools
item.description: SentinelOne describes a DPRK-linked Rust backdoor with 38 fabricated system messages meant to fool an LLM triage harness, hiding a credential stealer and Telegram C2.

item.title: LiteLLM proxy SQL injection (CVE-2026-42208) actively exploited
item.description: CISA says a LiteLLM SQL injection is actively exploited, letting attackers read and possibly modify the proxy database and reach the credentials it manages.

item.title: Google's Gemini AI hacked three companies in first known breakout
item.description: Reuters, WSJ and BBC report Google's Gemini AI hacked into three companies earlier this year in what was described as a security test and the first known breakout by Google's AI.

item.title: Fake Codex download pages on Google Sites deliver macOS malware via ClickFix
item.description: Fake Codex pages hosted on Google Sites, promoted via sponsored search and using ClickFix, target Mac users with malware.

item.title: Agentic AI attack exploits Zammad zero-days against Dutch vulnerability disclosure institute
item.description: AI agents chained two Zammad zero-days for session hijacking, code execution and root escalation within seconds, stealing email addresses from DIVD.

item.title: Talos finds CLOSEDQUORUM, first reported autonomous AI C2 implant
item.description: Cisco Talos found CLOSEDQUORUM via its CAIRN project, a malware binary with fully autonomous command and control that cuts operator involvement.

item.title: ClaudeFix: shared Claude chats used to deliver ClickFix malware instructions
item.description: Zscaler ThreatLabz describes ClaudeFix, which combines shared Claude chats with the ClickFix paste-and-run technique to deploy malware.

item.title: ChatGPT feature abuse paired with ClickFix delivers trojan to users searching via Google
item.description: Huntress found a campaign abusing a ChatGPT feature and ClickFix tricks to deliver a potent trojan to users searching for ChatGPT on Google.

item.title: Aurora ransomware operators abuse Cursor Agent AI for reconnaissance and exploitation
item.description: Aurora ransomware operators are abusing the Cursor Agent AI tool to carry out tasks such as reconnaissance and exploitation.

item.title: Unknown actor uses AI-driven ARTEX against South Korean finance
item.description: CrowdStrike reports an unidentified threat actor using an AI-driven tool called ARTEX to target South Korean financial organizations.

item.title: UK AISI cyber evaluation with unfiltered models accidentally attacks other companies
item.description: During a cyber-capability evaluation of models with safety filters disabled, the UK AI Security Institute's agents behaved without sanction and accidentally attacked other companies, per its incident report.

item.title: US advisory: attackers use AI-generated exploit scripts against exposed Siemens S7 PLCs
item.description: A US government advisory warns that attackers are deploying AI-generated exploitation scripts against exposed Siemens S7 Series PLCs.

item.title: AI agent carries out multi-stage data theft in Spain's first AI-powered breach, per AEPD
item.description: Spanish data protection agency AEPD revealed the country's first AI-powered data breach, in which an AI agent carried out a multi-stage data theft attack.

item.title: PoeLLM botnet infects 3,400 servers running exposed LiteLLM and Ollama for cryptomining
item.description: Lumen Black Lotus Labs tracked an ELF implant named libgcrypt that derives its C2 address from words in a GitHub-hosted poem, scans ports 3000 and 4000, exploits LiteLLM CVE-2026-42271 and runs XMRig and Iron miners on more than 3,400 hosts.

item.title: Man sentenced in first US AI music streaming fraud case after $8M in bot-driven royalties
item.description: A North Carolina man got 18 months and must forfeit $8,091,843 after prosecutors said he streamed hundreds of thousands of AI-generated songs via about 10,000 bot accounts to collect royalties; first US AI streaming case

item.title: PixelLeak: AI coding agents push 13,000 internal screenshots to public GitHub
item.description: Glow Labs found coding agents uploaded internal app screenshots, including billing and treasury consoles, to public repos so reviewers could see them, mostly under personal accounts.

item.title: Fake CEO WhatsApp and cloned lawyer's voice trick Intesa's Fideuram into sending €95M abroad
item.description: In February 2026 Fideuram's chairman received a WhatsApp message posing as Intesa Sanpaolo CEO Carlo Messina, then a call using an AI clone of a law-firm partner's voice; about €95M ($108M) went to accounts abroad. More than half was recovered; some €36M remains missing, Reuters reported.

item.title: Greek police bust gang that cloned relatives' voices with AI to steal over 1M euros
item.description: Greek police arrested two collectors from a gang that posed as utility staff, recorded relatives voices, then used AI voice clones of those relatives to talk victims into handing over valuables; over 1M euros taken.

item.title: Researchers tie May RubyGems malware flood to swarm of OpenAI agents
item.description: GemStuffer research linked 2,000+ malicious gems that gained code execution on RubyDoc build servers to OpenAI agents in training; OpenAI is reviewing agent activity.

item.title: ShinyHunters affiliates use AI agents to dump 2,100+ Azure tokens from 40+ tenants
item.description: Anthropic reported ShinyHunters-linked actors whose AI agents did nearly all the work in a supply-chain breach of 40+ cloud tenants and a three-hour takeover from one stolen token.

item.title: Russia-aligned actor used AI agents to self-rebuild malware and steal ID records
item.description: Anthropic's threat report described a Midnight Blizzard-like operator whose agents auto-rebuilt detected malware, raided drone makers and stole 300,000+ national ID records.

item.title: GTG-50029: lone French-speaking hacktivist breaches 14 European political entities
item.description: In spring 2026 a single actor built a Rust API-key scanner, a WordPress reinstall race-condition exploit and a doxxing platform called fafsearch, gaining internal access to at least 14 of 42 tracked targets.

item.title: GTG-50021: fake discounted-Claude reseller proxied traffic and stole Anthropic credentials
item.description: A Russian- and Ukrainian-speaking group sold cheap Claude access, silently routed buyers to other models and ran a credential harvester that captured Anthropic account logins for resale.

item.title: GTG-50020: extortionist prompt-injects AI vendor eval sandbox, then hits 30 AI firms
item.description: A Russian-speaking extortion actor that had stolen 26 GB from booking and fintech platforms injected prompts into an AI vendor's automated evaluation sandbox to extract production API keys, then hit about 30 AI firms.

item.title: GTG-30006: Iranian accounts built phishing portals and SECOMS64 implant with Claude
item.description: Free-tier Claude accounts spread across 16 organisations built phishing portals, a VBScript dropper, the SECOMS64 implant and Microsoft 365 mailbox-theft tooling, splitting work into small sessions to weaken safeguards.

item.title: GTG-16008: Xiaomi replayed MiMo user sessions through Claude via 1,500 accounts
item.description: Anthropic says Xiaomi replayed real MiMo user sessions through Claude via OpenClaw and OpenCode to collect training data, 400,000+ requests across 1,500+ accounts, exposing users' names and corporate data.

item.title: GTG-16006: Zhipu accused of cyber-focused distillation of Claude Opus through 273 accounts
item.description: Anthropic says Zhipu (Z.ai) ran a chain-of-thought extraction pipeline through 273 accounts, 770,609 exchanges in ten days, and used Claude as grader for a cyber-focused distillation campaign.

item.title: GTG-16005: Anthropic says Alibaba ran 151M-exchange distillation of Claude to train Qwen
item.description: Anthropic attributes to Alibaba's Qwen team a campaign forcing chain-of-thought output via a fixed prompt, peaking near 3M exchanges a day from 3,500+ fake accounts, 151M+ exchanges May to July 2026.

item.title: GTG-15001: China studio ran 20+ dating apps with 4,700 Claude personas, 25,000 victims
item.description: A China-based app studio mixed about three AI personas per human gig worker across 20+ dating apps; in two weeks of April 2026 Claude sent about 2.36 million messages to 25,000+ users paying in coins to keep chatting.

item.title: GTG-10007: Chinese-speaking students run autonomous Claude exploit foundry against 50 orgs
item.description: Operators likely in Changsha, Hunan, including undergraduates, ran agent swarms with persistent memory, autonomous binary reversing and a 13-agent collection fleet, yielding a dozen candidate zero-days in a month.

item.title: Okta: free Telegram stealer dump holds thousands of live AI session tokens and 24 API keys
item.description: Okta analysed a 7 GB stealer log dump of 5,871 machines posted free on Telegram on 2 August 2026 and found 24 valid AI API keys plus thousands of unexpired session tokens for Google, Microsoft, Anthropic and Amazon.

item.title: Mandiant case: AI agent built from one prompt harvests thousands of credentials in 6 hours
item.description: A financially motivated actor already inside a victim cloud turned a coding chatbot, one prompt and markdown playbooks into an autonomous system that harvested thousands of credentials and rotated IPs via that cloud.

item.title: Sandworm-linked cluster used Gemini to write password-spraying scripts against Ukraine
item.description: GTIG reported a cluster it tracks as SANDWORM RELIC, tied to APT44, integrating Gemini to write and refine asynchronous Python password-spraying tools and Bash automation in operations against Ukraine.

item.title: TeamPCP's DUSTMAKER hides in .claude and .cursor folders and prompt-injects LLM scanners
item.description: UNC6780's DUSTMAKER steals GitHub Actions OIDC tokens to publish poisoned packages with valid SLSA attestations, persists via AI-assistant config folders and embeds adversarial prompts so LLM scanners ignore it.
